cards.title: Complete acoustic-contact ROC face and a sharp quasiconvex interval
cards.scientific_scope: Homogeneous quartics F=alpha H+beta u^2+gamma j^2+delta uj on real 2x2 matrices, H=(u+v-2j)^2, u=|Ae1|^2, v=|Ae2|^2, j=det A. The four-dimensional space is an exposed acoustic-contact face of the full nine-dimensional left-SO(2)-invariant ROC cone.
cards.statement: For all real coefficients, F is ROC iff P=[[6beta+delta,delta],[delta,gamma]] and Q=[[8alpha,delta],[delta,2beta+delta]] are PSD. The contact-face extreme rays are H,u^2,j^2,J_r, where J_r=3rH/[8(r+2)]+r(r-1)u^2/6+j^2+r uj and r<-2 or r>0; these rays are extreme in the full invariant ROC cone. For r in I=[-21/8,-5/2], alpha H+r(r-1)u^2/6+j^2+r uj is QC iff ROC iff alpha>=3r/[8(r+2)]. Hence, for delta<0 and rho=(6beta+delta)/delta in I, QC iff ROC iff P,Q are PSD. The sharp base members on I are non-polyconvex.
assumptions: Quartic polynomial and the stated exact left-SO(2)-invariant contact-face coordinates; no assertion of an arbitrary-quartic classification.
QC means every affine background on bounded Lipschitz domains with W0^(1,4) perturbations; periodic version uses the same exact-form heat argument.
Sharp-QC certificate currently retained only on the closed interval I; the global two-LMI theorem is ROC, and r=0 is the alpha H+j^2 limiting case.
Extremality is restricted to the invariant cone; a ray can be exposed inside the contact face while nonexposed in the containing cone.
proof_spine: Acoustic vanishing at (I,e12) forces five independent coefficient constraints and exactly the four-dimensional contact face.
Two explicit acoustic tests force P,Q PSD; completing the conformal acoustic square proves each J_r ROC on both allowed branches.

cards.title: A smooth quasilinear escape reduces to the forbidden constant tangent
cards.scientific_scope: Homogeneous quartic polynomials F on R^(m x n), nondivergence quasilinear operations u_t=sum C^{ij}(Du)u_ij with C continuous at zero, and local all-compatible-Hessian positivity after a quadratic-Hessian null correction whose coefficient functions have a second-order Peano expansion.
cards.statement: If P_C(A,H)+N(A,H)>=0 for every A near zero and every compatible Hessian H, with the canonical P_C from one integration by parts and locally null N, then there is a globally null homogeneous A^2-H^2 density N2 such that P_C(0)(A,H)+N2(A,H)>=0 for every A,H. In the planar two-output case, freezing C and adding the exact bridge P_C-E_C=d eta_C gives a closed homogeneous-quadratic two-form certificate. Consequently the inherited FV exposed quartic, whose certificate is excluded for every constant strongly parabolic operator, also excludes every such continuous-at-zero adaptive operator with strongly parabolic tangent.
assumptions: F is a homogeneous quartic polynomial; N is a quadratic polynomial in compatible Hessian entries and has a coefficientwise second-order Peano expansion at zero.
N integrates to zero for every affine background and compact smooth perturbation staying in its coefficient neighborhood; positivity is pointwise on all jets, not only along one solution orbit.
The tangent theorem needs no ellipticity; the specific FV exclusion uses strongly parabolic C(0). No solution existence, long-time relaxation or boundary-value theorem is assumed.
The canonical density is P_C=sum F_(alpha k,beta l)(A)H_(beta,lk)G_alpha(A,H). Variable C(A) cannot simply be inserted into the constant E_C formula.
proof_spine: At A=0 the PSD null quadratic vanishes on spanning pure Hessian symbols, so N0=0; two-sided scaling removes N1.
Divide local positivity at tA by t^2, freeze C(tA) at C(0), and use the Peano remainder to get the global tangent inequality.
Scale both background and perturbation and divide the null integral by t^4 to prove full nullness of N2.
For frozen coefficients, the explicit cubic one-form eta_C satisfies P_C-E_C=d eta_C; the planar null classification supplies the other closed form.
Compose with the actual all-constant-operator FV separation rather than inferring non-QC from heat-certificate failure.
cards.costs: This is a proof-class reduction and exact symbolic audit, not a faster PDE solver or algorithm. Any flow existence, precision, convergence, relaxation or physical realization costs would need a separate operation contract.
cards.information_acquisition: The polynomial, coefficient family, nullity and all-jet inequality are mathematical premises. No measurement or physical nonlinear evolution is acquired. The inherited FV no-go is pinned as a separate proof premise.
cards.obstruction: A smooth strongly parabolic variable-coefficient example has integral(P_C-E_C)=3*pi^2*t^5, so the naive variable E_C substitution fails. Singular/angular non-Peano corrections, degenerate tangents, nonlocal/higher-jet mechanisms, time dependence and restricted-orbit positivity remain outside the root theorem. A C1,1 angular null example lacks a Peano second jet but does not prove cone enlargement.
cards.comparator: The fixed tangent operator is the comparator within this local certificate class. Classical null-Lagrangian/minor/closed-form machinery is credited. Ordinary variational/PDE proofs and nonlocal estimates remain available outside the declared operation.

cards.title: An actual-row pulse hard pair and the exact finite-ramp discrimination cost
cards.scientific_scope: Restricted positive-RC impedances with a common positive series inductance and 19-mode baseline, known zero incremental initial state, the supplied 58-point 0.01–904.7Hz EIS row with an assumed 0.1mOhm component box, and bounded incremental-current/time-domain voltage observations.
cards.statement: An exact positive-RC pair Z_+=B+2A*delta/(s+delta), Z_-=B+2A*delta/(s+2delta), A=125mOhm and delta=pi/2000 per second, satisfies the same actual 58-row EIS box and has Q_1000 respectively in [266.16089938984990,266.16089938985000] and [187.72905369456885,187.72905369456890]mOhm. Its step difference is d(t)=A(1-exp(-delta*t))^2 and impulse difference g=dprime>=0. Every |i|<=Imax waveform on [0,H] has separation <=Imax*d(H). With i(0)=0 and |iprime|<=Imax/rho, the exact optimum is the maximum ramp/plateau, with K(H,rho)=rho^(-1)*integral_(max(0,H-rho))^H d(v)dv. For deterministic adaptive strategies and bounded voltage error epsilon_V, informed-segment minimax absolute Q_T risk equals d(T)*min(1/2,eta/K), eta=epsilon_V/Imax. Randomized extension requires the erratum causal current-reactive error adversary.
assumptions: Known causal linear incremental model and zero initial increment; arbitrary prehistory, finite-amplitude nonlinear cell behavior and model discrepancy are separate.
eta is a new symbolic time-domain noise interface, not inferred from the EIS box or measured instrument uncertainty; use consistent mV/A=mOhm units.

The all-waveform lower bound covers deterministic finite sequential strategies or well-posed deterministic causal feedback. Randomized statements require causal current-reactive corruption; no oblivious fixed-noise randomized bound is claimed.
Exact minimax equality is for the supplied convex hard segment with known baseline; it is only a lower bound for the larger EIS-feasible class.
proof_spine: The common baseline/inductance cancels, and direct algebra produces a nonnegative impulse difference with exact quadratic early cancellation.
Convolution positivity proves the exact peak/slew induced separation over every bounded waveform; no input/time grid is a premise.
The midpoint transcript supplies admissible bounded errors in both worlds, including deterministic adaptation; the erratum specifies the stronger adversary for randomization.
A ramp endpoint plus feasible-interval midpoint achieves the informed-segment lower bound.
Exact Fractions verify every observed component and positive RC mode; directed interval strings enclose target values and duration thresholds.

cards.title: A collective-reference rare sampler with local marks and explicit finite-error limits
cards.scientific_scope: Supplied irreversible set-valued failure CTMCs stopped at the kth failure, 1<=k<=n, with count-reference rates b_s>0 and local nonnegative residuals a_i(x)=b_s/(n-s)*(1+eta_i(x)), 0<=eta_i<=beta/n. The reference conditional path law and its preparation are explicit prerequisites.
cards.statement: Let E={tau_k<=T}, h=P0(E)>0, p=P(E), M=(1+beta/n)^k<=exp(beta), and B=max b_s. The full stopped likelihood L=product(1+eta_i)*exp(-sum DeltaA_s*Delta_s) satisfies 0<L<=M, p>=h and E_Q0 L=p/h. Independent real-jump Bernoulli factors and uniform-alive-label Poisson marks accept a Q0=P0(.|E) path with probability L/M, producing exactly P(.|E) in the exact-real/reference-sampler model. Expected proposals <=M and expected local residual queries per accepted path <=M*(k+beta*B*T/n). hL has relative second moment <=M; Bernoulliized MhY has no statistical advantage over hL. For bounded beta these bounds hold at macroscopic k and complete k=n.
assumptions: All b_s, residual oracle/representation, component labels, horizon and nonnegative envelope are supplied and valid on every queried state; no repairs, hidden jumps or unmodelled channels.
Exact conditional reference draw and exact Poisson/Bernoulli/exponential primitives are assumptions for the ideal exact-path theorem; a fixed finite uniformization cutoff is approximate.
General uniformization pays B*T and O(kJ) recurrence arithmetic/storage, not a strongly polynomial guarantee in the binary length of arbitrary huge horizons/rates.
The new dense residual numerical fixture is n=k400, rho1 common acceleration, beta2, T1/5. It is distinct from the source rho2/distinct-baseline model and the thermal-avalanche target.
proof_spine: Complete stopped-path densities include the holding exponent and no post-stop survival factor.
Fresh unit-exponential coupling gives p>=h for arbitrary positive count rates, without a monotonicity premise.
Poisson thinning realizes the aggregate holding factor through local residual queries; independent rejection gives the exact conditional law and cost bound.
Conditional virtual-event count is dominated by k+Poisson(BT); auxiliary tail conditioning has an explicit target mass/TV bound.
The implemented fixture separately budgets rational count truncation, dyadic-time functional coupling, integer interval exponentials and fixed-N empirical Bernstein confidence.
cards.costs: Read/generate and store the supplied dense matrix in O(n^2); n400 uses 160000 int64 entries/1280000 bytes. A direct-weight path costs O(k^2) interaction arithmetic plus count/label sampling, sorting and interval kernels. Each local eta query can cost O(s) dense interaction reads. Reference DP, precision, random bits and source-model acquisition remain charged.
cards.information_acquisition: No physical rates or dense interaction matrix are acquired. Arbitrary eta tables can have exponential input; a unit local oracle is an explicit access contract. Dyadic time grids have TV distance one from the continuous path law; use a functional coupling rather than relabeling them exact. One-level avalanche conditioning had zero successes in both probes and does not establish useful relative efficiency; stationary reversible module machinery has incompatible assumptions.
